instruction_quality.task_name: Bouncing Squares with Shrinking Walls in Revideo
instruction_quality.task_summary: Reproduce a reference animation of 12 colored squares bouncing inside walls that shrink and recover across phases. The agent writes a Revideo TypeScript scene using algorithmic physics and renders it to match the reference video.

measures: /logs/verifier chmod 700 + rm -rf at verification start; /tests chmod 700 root-only
Agent runs as non-root 'agent' user; cannot write to system binaries, /etc/, /tests/, /logs/verifier/
pkill -9 -u agent before render; strace -f blocks until all children exit
Regex grep blocks fs/subprocess/eval/video-read patterns in project.tsx; 50KB size limit; literal/array/string/float density gates
Post-render strace log checked for openat() on reward files with write flags
Symlink check on output video; video copied to /tests/ before scoring

acknowledged_vectors.vector: Agent-modified node_modules survives clean-room (find excludes node_modules/*, backup only restored if dir missing)
acknowledged_vectors.reason: Strace catches reward file writes; agent has no access to reference video to embed; modified rendering code would produce garbage without correct scene data

acknowledged_vectors.vector: Strace grep only matches O_WRONLY, not O_RDWR flag on reward files
acknowledged_vectors.reason: /logs/verifier is chmod 700 root-only so agent-user open() with any write flag fails with EACCES regardless; strace is a second defense layer

acknowledged_vectors.vector: allow_internet=true permits network access during agent phase
acknowledged_vectors.reason: Clean-room wipes all downloaded content except node_modules; agent cannot read reference video to know what to reproduce; scoring uses reference from /tests/ which agent cannot access

reward_design.formula_explanation: Multiplicative gating ensures all three visual fidelity factors must be high for a non-trivial score, with SSIM cubic scaling above a 0.70 gate as the dominant quality signal.

components.name: gated_ssim
components.metric: RGB SSIM averaged over 60 sampled frames with temporal offset search (best of 7 shifts), cubic scaling above 0.70 gate

components.name: phash_similarity
components.metric: Per-frame perceptual hash (pHash) hamming distance normalized to [0,1]

components.name: duration_penalty
components.metric: Frame count ratio penalty, linear ramp within [0.75, 1.25], hard zero outside

dimension_analysis.name: gated_ssim
dimension_analysis.notes: Requires pixel-level visual fidelity across 60 sampled frames; cubic exponent above 0.70 gate makes high scores very demanding

dimension_analysis.name: phash_similarity
dimension_analysis.notes: Perceptual hash is more forgiving than SSIM but still requires correct shapes and layout; blank/random inputs score near 0

dimension_analysis.name: duration_penalty
dimension_analysis.notes: Correct duration is straightforward if the agent reads the reference metadata, but cannot compensate for bad visual quality due to multiplicative aggregation
